mechanism: Risedronate may impair gastrointestinal absorption of levodopa due to altered gastric pH and GI motility effects, potentially reducing carbidopa-levodopa bioavailability and therapeutic efficacy.
action: Separate administration by at least 30 minutes; take risedronate on an empty stomach in the morning, and carbidopa-levodopa at least 30 minutes later with food if needed, monitoring for reduced antiparkinsonian effect.
